title: The 4 Best Deep Fryers for Fried Chicken
h1: The 4 Best Deep Fryers for Fried Chicken
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for deep fryers for fried chicken, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at deep fryers for fried chicken using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Hamilton Beach Professional Style Electric Deep Fryer 35036
products.blurb: Key specs: 4.5-liter / 19-cup oil capacity, 1800W immersed heating element, Two baskets included.
strengths: 1800W immersed element recovers heat fast when cold chicken drops the oil temperature
Two baskets let you fry dark and white meat in separate batches without waiting on cleanup
4.5-liter capacity fits enough oil to fully submerge 6 to 8 bone-in pieces at once
Removable heating element and enamel-coated tank are dishwasher safe
limitations: Large footprint takes up real counter space compared to compact fryers
No digital timer, so you're tracking time separately
Two baskets means two things to store between uses

products.name: Presto Dual Daddy Electric Deep Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual-well design with removable divider, 1500W element, Automatic thermostat.
strengths: Removable divider lets you fry two pieces at once without the flavors mixing
Automatic thermostat holds a steady frying temperature without babysitting
Nonstick cast aluminum body wipes clean quickly after frying
Compact enough to store in a cabinet between uses
limitations: 1500W element is slower to recover than the higher-wattage Hamilton Beach or Cuisinart
8-cup capacity limits each well to 2 to 3 pieces at a time
No basket lift, so pieces come out with tongs

products.name: Cuisinart CDF-200P1 Professional Deep Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1-gallon removable stainless steel oil container, 1800W immersion heating element, 2.3-pound food capacity.
strengths: 2.3-pound food capacity handles a large single batch of bone-in pieces
1800W element matches the Hamilton Beach for fast temperature recovery
Removable oil container with a pour spout makes oil changes far less messy
Viewing window lets you check color without lifting the lid and losing heat
limitations: Single basket means sequential batches for a full cut-up bird
Bulkier housing than a compact dual-well unit
features: Adjustable temperature dial with viewing window

products.name: T-fal Ultimate EZ Clean Deep Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: 3.5-liter oil / 2.6-pound food capacity, 1700W element, Built-in oil filtration and drainage system.
strengths: Built-in filtration drains and filters oil through a charcoal filter for up to 10 more uses
Digital timer removes the guesswork on batch timing
Locking lid with a viewing window contains splatter during frying
Dishwasher-safe basket and lid speed up cleanup after a chicken dinner
limitations: 2.6-pound food capacity is smaller than the Cuisinart's per-batch capacity
1700W is slightly behind the Hamilton Beach and Cuisinart on recovery speed
Filtration system adds a few extra minutes to post-fry cleanup versus just wiping down
features: Built-in oil filtration and drainage system

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
